-- [36척 정밀 검증] 기존 PortScene.makeShip과 승인된 MareAssets/Naval만 사용한다.
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Ships=require(RS.Shared.Ships)
assert(#Ships.Blueprints==36 and #Ships.BlueprintFactions==7,"SHIP_36_BLUEPRINT_CONTRACT_FAIL")
local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
for _,g in player.PlayerGui:GetChildren() do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end
local ch=player.Character
if ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then ch.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true end
local old=workspace:FindFirstChild("MareShipBlueprintQA")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="MareShipBlueprintQA"
folder.Parent=workspace
local run=game:GetService("RunService")
pcall(function()run:UnbindFromRenderStep("MareShipBlueprintCamera")end)
run:BindToRenderStep("MareShipBlueprintCamera",Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function()
local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
local target=Vector3.new(8000,300,8000)
cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
cam.FieldOfView=72
cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(target+Vector3.new(0,85,305),target+Vector3.new(0,13,0))
end)
workspace:SetAttribute("MareShipBlueprintQAStatus","RUNNING")
return "SHIP_36_PREVIEW_PREPARED"

-- [36척 실조작] 대륙별 모델을 실제 라이브러리에서 복제하고 선체·돛대 크기를 측정한다.
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ships=require(RS.Shared.Ships)
local ids=require(RS.Shared.AssetIds)
local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene)
local folder=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild("MareShipBlueprintQA"),"SHIP_PREVIEW_FOLDER_MISSING")
folder:ClearAllChildren()
local listed={}
for _,bp in ships.Blueprints do if bp.faction=="europe" then table.insert(listed,bp) end end
assert(#listed==5,"SHIP_CONTINENT_COUNT:europe")
local naval=assert(RS:FindFirstChild("MareAssets") and RS.MareAssets:FindFirstChild("Naval"),"SHIP_NAVAL_LIBRARY_MISSING")
local alias={galleon="galleon-heritage"}
for i,bp in listed do
 local asset=alias[bp.id] or (bp.id.."-custom")
 assert(ids["Naval/"..asset]~=nil,"SHIP_ASSET_ID_MISSING:"..bp.id)
 local deadline=os.clock()+140
 local template=naval:FindFirstChild(asset)
 while not template and os.clock()<deadline do
  task.wait(0.5)
  template=naval:FindFirstChild(asset)
 end
 assert(template and template:IsA("Model"),"SHIP_MODEL_IMPORT_MISSING:"..bp.id..":"..asset)
 local meshParts=0
 for _,p in template:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("MeshPart") then meshParts+=1 end end
 assert(meshParts>=1,"SHIP_MODEL_NOT_A_REAL_MESH:"..bp.id)
 local pos=Vector3.new(8000+(i-(#listed+1)/2)*74,300,8000)
 local ship=assert(PS.makeShip(folder,bp.id,pos),"SHIP_PORT_RENDER_MISSING:"..bp.id)
 local _,size=ship:GetBoundingBox()
 assert(size.X>=bp.targetLengthStuds*0.55 and size.X<=bp.targetLengthStuds*1.4,"SHIP_LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE:"..bp.id..":"..tostring(size.X))
end
workspace:SetAttribute("MareShipBlueprintQAStatus","PASS:europe")
return "SHIP_CONTINENT_RUNTIME_PASS:europe:"..#listed
